node_names: Year 12 / Groups in Context / Characteristics and needs of community groups / Rural and remote families

content.text: How could the characteristics of individuals living in a rural and remote location affect a family's access to services?

Sample answer: Individuals from rural and remote families may have lower socioeconomic status during drought or flood, affecting access to high-fee health services, and people with disabilities may have to travel long distances for specialised care.

items: 7 marks: demonstrates a thorough understanding of how the characteristics of individuals living in a rural and remote location affect a family's access to services.
6 marks: demonstrates a sound understanding of how the characteristics affect access to services.
4-5 marks: demonstrates an understanding of how the characteristics of individuals living in a rural and remote location affect a family's access to services.
2-3 marks: demonstrates some understanding of characteristic(s) of individuals in rural and remote families and/or their access to service(s).

node_names: Year 12 / Parenting and Caring / Parenting / social parents
Year 12 / Parenting and Caring / Parenting / special needs, eg illness, disability

content.text: How can the wellbeing of social parents be affected by the responsibility of making health and medical decisions for a dependant?

Sample answer: Social parents such as foster and stepparents are often legally unable to make major health decisions, which can cause stress, frustration and helplessness affecting their emotional wellbeing.

items: 8 marks: provides a thorough understanding of how the wellbeing of social parents can be affected by the responsibilities of making health and medical decisions for a dependant.
6-7 marks: provides a sound understanding of how the wellbeing of social parents can be affected.
4-5 marks: provides some understanding of how the wellbeing of social parent(s) can be affected.
2-3 marks: demonstrates some understanding of the impact on parent(s) when making health and/or medical decisions for a dependant.
